Initial public release of Subscription Slayer.

- Tracks and analyzes subscription spending with monthly and annual cost breakdowns.
- Detects likely-unused (wasteful) subscriptions based on last-used date and other factors.
- Ranks subscriptions by waste probability score and provides actionable recommendations.
- Generates ready-to-send cancellation email templates for high-waste subscriptions.
- Supports easy command-line usage with customizable thresholds and demo data.
